Name: Apex Legends
Source: Apex Legends in-game Controller Presets screen, preset Default (recommended preset in EA's accessibility notes), stick layout Default. Transcribed from a screenshot supplied by the project owner (Nov 2026); the screenshot shows the Xbox One pad with PlayStation button icons. Other presets (Bumper Jumper, Button Puncher, Evolved, Grenadier, Ninja) and the Southpaw/Legacy stick layouts are not modelled.
Notes: Ultimate Ability is L1 + R1 together (not a separate button). Left stick moves, right stick looks. PS button and touchpad click are not on the preset.

Native.X / Square: Interact / Pickup / Reload  ·  hold: Interact / Pickup
Native.DPad Up: Use Health/Shield Kit  ·  hold: Health Wheel
Native.DPad Right: Toggle Fire Mode  ·  hold: Equip Survival Item
Native.DPad Left: Extra Character Action  ·  hold: Emote Wheel
